taskVersion.name: ves-real-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Gokana-street (Bori Metropolis). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1420 | 1.44 | 1.44
2 | 859 | 1.49 | 2.93
3 | 987 | 14.5 | 17.4
4 | 2246 | 33.5 | 50.9
5 | 34337 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Gokana-street (Bori Metropolis)
Curve type: HAA type
Aquifer depth: 17.4 – 50.9 m
Recommendation: Target the 33.5 m-thick sandy aquifer unit between 17.4 m and 50.9 m depth (ρ ≈ 2246 Ω·m), which shows sufficient thickness and resistivity contrast to be a productive water-bearing zone; terminate drilling before encountering the underlying highly resistive basement/consolidated layer (>34,000 Ω·m) below 50.9 m, as it is unlikely to yield water.
